  • Reference

    Stable isotope signatures of benthos and common sole

    isotopes.Rd

    Stable isotope data for benthic organisms and common sole (Solea solea) collected during the CAPES and CHOPIN projects in the Seine estuary.

    Format

    A tibble with 285 rows and 21 variables:

    sample_TAG

    Character. Unique sample identifier used in the CAPES or CHOPIN project.

    species

    Factor. Taxonomic identifier of the sampled organism. Genus and species names are separated by an underscore. The dataset includes benthic invertebrates and common sole ("Solea_solea").

    season

    Character. Sampling season, corresponding to spring or autumn.

    zone

    Character. Sampling area within the Seine estuary, including "Chenal", "Embouchure", "Fosse Nord", and "Fosse Sud".

    site

    Character. Sampling-site identifier.

    num_increment

    Character. Identifier of the sample or analytical increment used for stable isotope measurements.

    delta13C

    Numeric. Carbon stable isotope signature, expressed as delta-13-C values.

    delta15N

    Numeric. Nitrogen stable isotope signature, expressed as delta-15-N values.

    C_percent

    Numeric. Carbon content of the analysed sample, expressed as a percentage of dry mass.

    N_percent

    Numeric. Nitrogen content of the analysed sample, expressed as a percentage of dry mass.

    source

    Character. Project from which the observation originates, with values "CAPES" and "CHOPIN".

    labels

    Character. Abbreviated taxonomic label used for figures and tables.

    taxa

    Character. Broad taxonomic group of the organism, including "Bivalves", "Polychaetes", "Crustaceans", and "Fish".

    feeding_mode

    Character. Feeding-mode category of the organism. Categories include "Susp." for suspension feeder, "Dep.sur." for surface deposit feeder, "Dep.sub." for subsurface deposit feeder, "Susp.Dep.sur." for suspension and surface deposit feeder, and "Omnivore" for omnivore.

    mobility

    Character. Functional mobility category of the organism, with values "Sedentary", "Low mobility", and "Mobile".

    lip_dw_percent

    Numeric. Lipid content expressed as a percentage of dry weight. Available only for a subset of samples.

    class

    Character. Age class of common sole, with values "G0" and "G1". Missing for benthic organisms.

    stade

    Character. Composite stage identifier used for common sole, combining species, age class, and stage category (e.g. "Solea_solea.G0.S1"). Missing for benthic organisms.

    length_TL_cm

    Numeric. Total length of common sole. Missing for benthic organisms.

    lon

    Numeric. Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees.

    lat

    Numeric. Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees.

    Source

    CAPES and CHOPIN projects, Seine estuary.

    Details

    The dataset contains carbon and nitrogen stable isotope signatures, taxonomic and functional information, sampling location, and selected biological characteristics of common sole.

    Stable isotope signatures are expressed as delta values for carbon (\(\delta^{13}C\)) and nitrogen (\(\delta^{15}N\)).

    The dataset combines benthic invertebrates and common sole in order to characterize trophic relationships and support analyses of contaminant transfer through the benthic food web.

    Biological traits for benthic taxa and common sole are included directly in the dataset through the taxa, feeding_mode, and mobility variables.

    Variables class, stade, and length_TL_cm apply to common sole and are missing for benthic organisms.

    See also

    benthos_info, soles_info
